استثنيت (form X)
# اِسْتَثْنَيْتُ (istaṯnaytu) /is.taθ.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اِسْتَثْنَيْتَ (istaṯnayta) /is.taθ.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اِسْتَثْنَيْتِ (istaṯnayti) /is.taθ.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اُسْتُثْنِيتُ (ustuṯnītu) /us.tuθ.niː.tu/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
